color.note: Light only: every Sentri screen declares color-scheme light. Names match the CSS custom properties the prototypes already use, so tokens.css drops straight in.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The studio/desk background behind the phone canvas. Never inside the app.

tokens.name: app-background
tokens.usage: The app canvas: status bar, task header, full-page sheets. Pages put white `paper` panels on it.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Panels on a page, drawer bodies, footers, secondary buttons, text fields.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Quiet raised area on the canvas (sync card, summary blocks).

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Panels inside a drawer (the drawer itself is `paper`), notes fields, short chooser insets.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, tool buttons, unit-number chips. Also exported as `--wash`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, and the fill of every primary button (white label). 14.6:1 on `paper`, 13.4:1 on `app-background`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, fact labels, group headings, chevrons. 5.2:1 on `paper`, 4.8:1 on `app-background`, 4.6:1 on `well` — do not set it on anything darker.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders, header and footer dividers, icon-button borders. Decorative (1.3:1): it separates surfaces that already differ, never marks a control on its own.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline between rows inside a panel. Rules appear only between rows, never above the first.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Text fields, picker triggers and secondary buttons. Source value; 1.8:1 on `paper`, below the 3:1 control-border floor — the label and the 44px+ geometry carry the control today.

tokens.name: back-border
tokens.usage: The Back button in sheet footers and the paired secondary in drawer footers.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done / recorded / synced, the selected check in pickers, the wordmark dot. 6.9:1 on `paper`. Never a button fill: primary actions are `ink`.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Current-location row background, pressed task in the context card, synced summary.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Due now / waiting to upload. Text and icons only (5.6:1 on `paper`). Never decorative.

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a pending/attention block that carries `amber` text.

tokens.name: pending-surface
tokens.usage: Sync card and sync summary while records wait to upload; border `pending-border`.

tokens.name: pending-border
tokens.usage: Border of `pending-surface` blocks.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive and ending actions only (Delete photo, End task): filled with white label, 6.6:1. Also field error borders.

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: The "End early" button: `red-wash` fill, `red` border and label.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: In-progress status word. 5.8:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px (rows: offset -3px). 4.2:1 on `paper`, 3.9:1 on `app-background`.

tokens.name: current-marker
tokens.usage: The 3px inset bar on the current-location row and the underline of the active category tab.

tokens.name: tab-ink
tokens.usage: Inactive category-footer tab labels. 4.9:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: tab-ink-active
tokens.usage: Active category-footer tab label (700 weight).

tokens.name: row-icon-bg
tokens.usage: The 34px rounded tile behind a row's leading icon.

tokens.name: row-icon-ink
tokens.usage: Stroke colour of a row's leading icon.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a row or picker option.

tokens.name: choice-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a chooser row.

tokens.name: log-line
tokens.usage: The vertical thread of an activity log.

tokens.name: log-dot
tokens.usage: The 7px node on each log entry.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: The 92×4px home-indicator bar at the foot of pages and footers.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Disabled primary button fill and border.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Disabled button label. Exempt from contrast by definition — never use for live text.

tokens.name: count-surface
tokens.usage: The hero count area in the piglet count sheet.

tokens.name: count-ink
tokens.usage: The hero count figure on `count-surface`.

tokens.name: count-key
tokens.usage: The filled +1 key of the hero stepper (white glyph).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The rulings' ink2: the text-action register (a bare word, no container). 8.3:1 on `paper`, 7.7:1 on `app-background`, 7.3:1 on `well`.

tokens.name: amber-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The correction banner's wash, strong enough to read as amber in sunlight; `amber` text holds 4.6:1 on it and its border is `amber`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a drawer, with a 1.4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: dialog-backdrop
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a centred or bottom dialog.

tokens.name: frame-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The phone frame's 1px edge when a task page renders inside the 390×844 frame on a wider screen (TaskPhone). Device chrome, never inside the app.

tokens.name: chip-green-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The border of a green status chip on an animal row (TaskRow chip `green`: in progress). The chip is `green` on `green-wash`.

tokens.name: chip-red-border
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The border of a red status chip on an animal row (TaskRow chip `red`: a terminal fact, `Sow died`). The chip is `red` on `red-wash`.

tokens.name: progress-active
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The middle segment of the summary card's task progress bar (TaskSummary): started, not finished. Done is `current-marker`, not started is `handle`, the track is `line`.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: st-heading kind page; task header h2 (20px under 370px, and in a drawer).

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: Utility header, page header and dialog h3.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: st-heading kind section — the default heading above a panel.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: st-heading kind panel, inside a panel.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: st-heading kind group, in `muted`: log groups, row-group labels.

styles.name: chooser-heading
styles.usage: Title above a chooser panel, in `muted`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Footer buttons and Back. Lone footer Back takes 600.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Text fields and picker triggers.

styles.name: choice-label
styles.usage: Chooser row label; 600 when selected.

styles.name: fact-value
styles.usage: The value half of a fact.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Row and log-entry title.

styles.name: choice-meta
styles.usage: Chooser row second line, in `muted`.

styles.name: description
styles.usage: Row subtitles, heading descriptions, fact labels — `muted`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Heading meta and log timestamps, `muted`. The floor: nothing smaller except log categories (9px).

styles.name: hero-count
styles.usage: The one number a count sheet exists to set. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Task facts and metrics on overview cards.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Route counts, environment readings.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: Ear tags, pen codes, unit numbers — every ID a worker reads off the barn.

styles.name: identifier-strong
styles.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The lead identifier of a list row (Row `code`): a crate code the eye runs down.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small location overlines and badge counts, `muted`.

styles.name: figure-card
styles.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The lead figure of each half of the task summary card (TaskSummary): the unit figure and the task-overview count.

styles.name: figure-denominator
styles.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The `/ n` after the task-overview count on the summary card, `muted`.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of the task header, drawer footers and category footer.

tokens.name: space-gutter-sheet
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of full-page sheet bodies, utility headers and page footers.

tokens.name: space-gutter-narrow
tokens.usage: Every gutter and panel padding at 370px wide and below.

tokens.name: space-panel
tokens.usage: Panel, facts and log padding.

tokens.name: space-row-x
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding (chooser rows use 16px).

tokens.name: space-row-y
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, and the gap between a row's icon, copy and chevron.

tokens.name: space-heading
tokens.usage: Space under a section heading, before its panel (8px under a group label).

tokens.name: space-footer-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a footer (16px beside the category tabs).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between two sections of a page (--st-space-section) and between log groups.

tokens.name: space-action-section
tokens.usage: Between categories on an actions page.

tokens.name: space-footer-bottom
tokens.usage: Footer bottom padding: leaves room for the home-indicator handle.

tokens.name: space-key-gap
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. Gap between stepper keys and their value, and between Numpad keys.

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The side padding of each half of the task summary card (TaskSummary).

tokens.name: space-animal-row-y
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The top and bottom padding of an animal row in a grouped list (TaskRow); with `animal-row-min` it gives farrowing's 76px row.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, facts, logs, chooser panels, the task context card (--st-radius).

tokens.name: radius-inset
tokens.usage: Short chooser insets and count comparison blocks.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, picker triggers, icon buttons, the Back button.

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track and the row icon tile (its buttons take 8px).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a drawer (0 when presented as a page).

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Top corners of a bottom dialog.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. A lens tab's pressed face inside its `radius-segment` track (TaskLens).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. An animal row's status chip (TaskRow).

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The phone frame's corners on a wider screen (TaskPhone). Device chrome, never inside the app.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The task context card only. Panels have no shadow: a 1px `line` border separates them.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A drawer rising over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: A bottom dialog over its backdrop.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Every tappable thing is at least 44×44 (heading actions extend their hit area with negative margin).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Footer buttons, Back, filter and icon buttons.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text field and picker-trigger minimum height.

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Row minimum height.

tokens.name: choice-row-min
tokens.usage: Chooser row and picker option minimum height.

tokens.name: back-width
tokens.usage: The fixed Back button in a footer beside other controls.

tokens.name: row-icon
tokens.usage: Row leading icon tile.

tokens.name: stepper-row-min
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. Stepper row minimum height (the craft pass's glove spacing); each key's hit area spans it.

tokens.name: hero-key
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The hero stepper's − and + keys (the count sheet's one number).

tokens.name: glyph-key
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The − / + glyph box in a row stepper key (stroke 2.2).

tokens.name: glyph-key-hero
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The − / + glyph box in a hero stepper key (stroke 2.2).

tokens.name: glyph-pad
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The backspace glyph box on a Numpad key (stroke 1.8).

tokens.name: caret-width
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The typing caret in an active Measure or Numpad readout, and the extra inset ring of the active box.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: Candidate (field cards, ds/field-cards, ADR 0001) — not approved. The dot before a status hint (amber warn), as on status words.

tokens.name: radio-size
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The ring box of a visible radio (ChoiceList `radio`), in rows and inline.

tokens.name: radio-dot
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The ink dot inside a selected radio (RULINGS craft pass: 10px).

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The radio ring (2px; ink3 maps to `muted`, selected `ink`).

tokens.name: ring-width-fine
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The Photos camera circle's ring (RULINGS craft pass: a 1.5px ink3 ring; ink3 maps to `muted`).

tokens.name: radio-row-min
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. A radio row's minimum height: the whole 60px row is the target (RULINGS craft pass).

tokens.name: photo-tile
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. A photo thumbnail tile inside the Photos card (five to a 390px row).

tokens.name: row-code-min
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The leading mono identifier column of a Row (`code`), so crate codes line up down a list.

tokens.name: row-chip-max
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The widest a Row's one status chip may grow before it wraps (chips are 14 characters or fewer).

tokens.name: phone-width
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The phone frame's width on a wider screen (TaskPhone); at phone width the task fills the screen.

tokens.name: phone-height
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The phone frame's height on a wider screen (TaskPhone).

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The simulated status bar at the top of the phone frame (TaskPhone); a drawer's scrim starts under it.

tokens.name: animal-row-min
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The minimum height of an animal row in a grouped list (TaskRow).

tokens.name: animal-id-col
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The width of an animal row's identity column (mono id over its chip), so every headline starts on one left edge (TaskRow).

tokens.name: grab-height
tokens.usage: Candidate (task skeleton, fix/skeleton, ADR 0003) — not approved. The grab strip at the top of a drawer (TaskSheet); its bar is 42×4.

weight.note: Font weights beyond the type styles. Candidate group (ADR 0002).

tokens.name: type-weight-strong
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The ruled 700: a selected radio label, the text action, the HOLD caption, the warning headline.

tokens.name: hold-sweep-opacity
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The hold sweep over the button fill (the dead drawer's 35% ink).

tokens.name: hold-caption-opacity
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The HOLD caption under the verb (RULINGS craft pass: 85%).

motion.note: Durations the cards read. Candidate group (ADR 0002); the README's Motion section still states the rest in prose.

tokens.name: hold-commit
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. The hold-to-commit sweep (Button `hold`): farrowing's Lock and the sow's death, End task.

tokens.name: hold-arm
tokens.usage: Candidate (design-system candidates 2, ds/candidates-2, ADR 0002) — not approved. How long a keyboard or switch press keeps a hold button armed for its second press.

drawer.note: Drawer heights as a share of the phone canvas. Compact and short size to content up to the cap; medium and long hold their height.

tokens.name: drawer-compact-max
tokens.usage: One question or a few choices.

tokens.name: drawer-short-max
tokens.usage: A short form or list.

tokens.name: drawer-medium-max
tokens.usage: The default drawer.

tokens.name: drawer-long-max
tokens.usage: A long list or catalogue that still keeps the page visible above it.
